Beyond the report

Practice: W T F R (day letters = Wed/Thu/Fri; purple = rest day, not injury; grey = not yet reported) Game: OUT DOUBTFUL QUEST. PROBABLE INACTIVE Games missed: "Missed last game (Wk 5)" / "Missed last 3 games (Wks 3–5)" come from each week's official game-day inactive lists (plus the date a player went on IR/PUP/NFI); a dashed tag means he played last game but missed earlier ones. Reserve lists: IR, PUP and NFI players, plus suspended and exempt. "Activate by" is the end of a player's 21-day practice window; "Wk 7" is the first week he can return.
